In our comment thread, I was kind of making the point of whether or not we could remove this fallback altogether. It seems like we believe the right approach is either:
1. Have the fallback and use it in both legacycaller and item (unified), matches Chrome today
2. Not have the fallback at all (still unified), matches FireFox today

Edge only supports the string prose on all("1") today so I'm open to aligning with FireFox rather than expanding the item("1") case? Maybe? Thoughts? If so, this entire prose goes away.

Per @foolip tests:
**FireFox**

```
log: document.all["1"] => <head>
log: document.all("1") => <div id="1">
log: document.all.item("1") => <div id="1">
```

**Edge**

```
log: document.all["1"] => <head>
log: document.all("1") => <head>
log: document.all.item("1") => <div id="1">
```

**Chrome**

```
log: document.all["1"] => <head>
log: document.all("1") => <head>
log: document.all.item("1") => <head>
```
